description: PowerCascade: A Synthetic Dataset for Cascading Failure Analysis in Power Systems is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Tingwei Chen, Kaiyang Huang. "This dataset supports research on cascading failures in power systems and their mitigation using artificial intelligence techniques. It comprises a large set of simulated cascading events generated from a realistic power grid model. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
